name: Groups
tip: Public group chat. Messages are NOSTR notes tagged with the group, and messages from NomadNet (LXMF) land here too.

children.name: add_group
children.tip: Join a group

children.name: recur
children.tip: Repeat this message periodically

children.name: room_members
children.tip: Members & moderation (rooms only)

name: Members
tip: Who is in this room, with their reputation level. Admins and moderators can tap a member to award or deduct points, suspend, kick or ban.

name: Follows
tip: Callsigns you follow appear in your Activity feed.

children.name: follow
children.label: Follow a callsign
children.tip: Follow a callsign — their posts, replies, likes and status appear in your Activity feed.

children.name: follows_list
children.tip: Who you follow and who follows you; tap a row for the profile.

children.name: beacon_interval
children.label: Auto-beacon interval (s)
children.tip: Seconds between automatic beacons when auto-beacon is on.

children.name: send_beacon
children.label: Send beacon
children.tip: Transmit a beacon of the selected type now.

children.name: toggle_timed
children.label: Toggle auto-beacon
children.tip: Start/stop beaconing every interval.

children.name: status
children.label: Activity
children.tip: Connection and transmit log.

name: APRS (legacy)
tip: Legacy APRS-IS access — requires a government-issued amateur-radio callsign. Reticulum is the primary transport and needs no licence. Off by default.

children.name: aprsis
children.tip: LEGACY: APRS-IS carries traffic onto licensed amateur-radio networks, so it requires a callsign assigned by your local radio authority. The auto-generated Geogram callsign (X1…) is not valid there. While this switch is off, Geogram never connects to APRS-IS — messaging works fully over Reticulum (primary) and Bluetooth.

children.name: aprsis_enabled
children.label: Use APRS-IS (legacy, ham licence required)
children.tip: Enable the APRS-IS connection using the licensed callsign below. Verified with “Verify & apply”.

children.name: aprsis_call
children.label: Licensed callsign
children.tip: Your authority-assigned amateur callsign, optionally with an SSID, e.g. N0CALL-9. Used for the APRS-IS login and as your station callsign while APRS-IS is enabled.

children.name: aprsis_pass
children.label: APRS-IS passcode
children.tip: The numeric APRS-IS passcode for your callsign. It is verified before the switch takes effect.

children.name: aprs_apply
children.label: Verify & apply
children.tip: Check the callsign + passcode and apply the switch. With a wrong passcode APRS-IS stays disabled.

children.name: network
children.tip: APRS-IS server and digipeater path.

children.name: connect
children.label: Connect
children.tip: Connect to APRS-IS now (requires the switch above).

children.name: aprs_status
children.label: Status
children.tip: APRS-IS connection log.

name: Settings
tip: Station identity, position, network and filter.

children.name: identity
children.tip: Your station.

children.name: symbol
children.label: Symbol
children.tip: Two chars: table + code. "/>" is a car.

children.name: position
children.tip: Your position and how far around it to listen.

children.name: bluetooth
children.tip: Exchange short messages directly over Bluetooth, off-grid.

children.name: ble_enabled
children.label: Exchange over Bluetooth
children.tip: Scan for and broadcast chat frames over BLE (shared with other apps).

children.name: ble_relay
children.label: Act as an iGate (bridge Bluetooth ↔ APRS-IS)
children.tip: When online, gate APRS messages heard over Bluetooth to APRS-IS, and relay APRS-IS messages addressed to Bluetooth stations in range back to them. On by default.

children.name: media
children.tip: Images shared in messages are fetched over the network. Large ones can wait for an explicit tap.

children.name: media_auto_mb
children.label: Auto-download images up to (MB)
children.tip: Images at or below this size download automatically; larger ones show their size and a tap-to-download button. Set 0 to always tap to download.

children.name: identity_broadcast
children.tip: Periodically broadcast your public key so other stations can map your callsign to it and send you encrypted messages.

children.name: pubkey_beacon
children.label: Broadcast my public key
children.tip: Every 30 min, send your profile's public key (base64, ~43 chars) as a bulletin to group NOSTR over Reticulum, Bluetooth and (when enabled) APRS-IS. Peers learn your callsign → pubkey so they can message you encrypted.

children.name: pubkey_apply
children.label: Apply key broadcast
children.tip: Save the setting above and send one broadcast now.

children.name: sign_msgs
children.label: Sign my messages
children.tip: Append a short cryptographic signature (~60 chars, one extra line) to outgoing messages so others can verify they came from your callsign. Verifying needs the sender's broadcast public key.

children.name: sign_apply
children.label: Apply signing
children.tip: Save the message-signing setting above.

children.name: center
children.label: Center map
children.tip: Recenter the map on your position.

name: Tools
tip: Network tools — ping the local Bluetooth mesh to test reach.

children.name: ping_group
children.tip: Ping nearby stations over Bluetooth; each digipeater replies with its callsign, hop count and location.

children.name: ping
children.label: Send ping
children.tip: Broadcast a BLE ping; nearby stations reply with callsign, hops and location.

children.name: pingresults
children.label: Responses
children.tip: Stations that answered, with hop count and distance.

name: Keys
tip: Public keys collected from other stations' NOSTR beacons — the basis for sending them encrypted messages.

children.name: keys_group
children.tip: Each station that broadcasts its public key is recorded here (callsign, key fingerprint, time since last heard).

children.name: keys_refresh
children.label: Refresh
children.tip: Rebuild the list from the stored key database.

children.name: keys_list
children.label: Known public keys
children.tip: callsign  key-fingerprint..  age. The full key is stored for encryption.
